references.text: The preceding verse describes the six pillars at the back of the tabernacle, which verse 24 builds upon by explaining the construction of the corner pillars.
A parallel text describing the actual execution of what was commanded in 26:24, where the corner pillars were joined from the bottom and fastened together at the top with a single ring.
Describes the silver sockets on which the pillars were to stand, providing context for the bottom (מִלְּמַטָּה) mentioned in verse 24.
Describes the crossbars that were to hold the pillars together, completing the construction of the corner pillars described in verse 24.
